title: Vision: Data-Centric Anchoring for Robust and Interpretable Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.08216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems built on large language models fail in two persistent ways that scaling does not fix: they break under distribution shift, and they cannot explain the decisions they make. We argue these are co-symptoms of one structural deficiency in the data lifecycle that governs how agents are trained, evaluated, and deployed. Observational interaction logs record what an agent did, not what it would have done otherwise. They encode spurious correlations without controlled variation, so they lack the counterfactual structure needed to separate causal signal from coincidence or to validate an explanation. No model-centric method can recover invariances the data never contained. We present Data-Centric Anchoring: robustness and interpretability should be engineered into the data environment, not extracted from models after training. Our central contribution is the Data-Centric Agentic Loop, a four-stage framework of Curate, Augment,

translated_title: 愿景：面向稳健且可解释的智能体AI的数据中心锚定
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型构建的智能体AI系统存在两种规模化无法解决的持续性缺陷：它们在分布偏移下会失效，并且无法解释自己所做的决策。我们认为，这两者是同一个结构性缺陷的共同症状，该缺陷存在于支配智能体如何被训练、评估和部署的数据生命周期中。观察性交互日志记录的是智能体实际做了什么，而不是它本来可以做什么。它们在缺乏受控变化的情况下编码了虚假相关性，因此缺乏将因果信号与巧合区分开来或验证解释所需的反事实结构。任何以模型为中心的方法都无法恢复数据中从未包含的不变性。我们提出了数据中心锚定：稳健性和可解释性应当被工程化地构建到数据环境中，而不是在训练之后从模型中提取。我们的核心贡献是数据中心智能体循环，这是一个包含策划、增强……的四阶段框架。
tldr: 论文提出“数据中心锚定”理念及四阶段的数据中心智能体循环框架，主张将稳健性和可解释性预先工程化地构建到数据环境中，从根本上解决智能体AI在分布偏移下失效且无法解释决策的结构性缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "Data-Centric Anchoring" with a four-stage Data-Centric Agentic Loop, arguing that robustness and interpretability should be engineered into the data environment to fundamentally fix agentic AI's failure under distribution shift and its inability to explain decisions.
